_comment: Honesty guard for article bodies (framework/core/article_claims_guard.py). Storage copy at config/article-claims-guard-config.json overrides this repo default. Site key matches by substring against the rec's agent_id / site hint. Each check is reject | warn | off; 'reject' refuses the implementer INSERT and re-queues the rec with the offending sentences as the addendum. point_prices applies only to the buckets in price_buckets (buying guides; never recipe clusters, where cost per serving is the point). 2026-09-25 AI-visibility audit F119/F075/F100/F108/F120.
